landing.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
landing.faq.description: Everything you need to know about CubistAI.
landing.faq.what_is.question: What is CubistAI?
landing.faq.what_is.answer: CubistAI is a free AI image generator that turns your text prompts into high-definition images instantly. No design skills required — just describe what you want and our AI creates it in seconds.
landing.faq.how_works.question: How does the AI image generator work?
landing.faq.how_works.answer: Simply type a description of the image you want to create. For example: 'a cinematic street portrait at golden hour' or 'a cute yellow dragon sticker in Pixar style'. The AI understands your prompt and generates a matching image within seconds.
landing.faq.free.question: Is CubistAI really free to use?
landing.faq.free.answer: Yes! The Free plan restores your balance to 10 credits every day, with no sign-up required to start. You can upgrade to Starter, Plus, or Pro anytime for more credits, higher resolution, and faster generation.
landing.faq.commercial.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
landing.faq.commercial.answer: Yes. All images generated with CubistAI come with full commercial usage rights. Use them for marketing, social media, websites, merchandise, client projects, and more — no extra licensing fees.
landing.faq.models.question: Which AI models are available?
landing.faq.models.answer: CubistAI ships the latest models including GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, and dedicated tools for headshots, cartoons, coloring pages, and video. Higher tiers unlock more models, higher resolutions (up to 4K), and concurrent tasks.
